configuration: Slack morning planning and evening reflection, fixed-goal PITCH-N and rotating-goal PITCH-R.

S->M.label: reported
S->M.rationale: User messages enter stored daily conversations, reused that evening.

M->A.label: reported
M->A.rationale: Morning history and goal enter the evening prompt, shaping follow-up questions.

A->S.label: reported
A->S.rationale: Goal-directed questions acquire users' plans, constraints, and results of suggested activities.

M->S.label: insufficient
M->S.rationale: History-guided questioning establishes M→A→S; direct memory guidance of sensing is unspecified.

A->M.label: reported
A->M.rationale: Stored conversations include PITCH's utterances, subsequently supplied as morning context.

record.label: stated
record.rationale: PITCH retains its utterances and reuses morning history for evening assistance.
record.quote: store daily conversations and associated metadata.

outcome.label: stated
outcome.rationale: Replies reporting benefits from PITCH's suggestions enter stored conversations.
outcome.quote: I did, it was really beneficial

attribution.label: stated
attribution.rationale: Scheduling feedback corrects PITCH's preceding mindfulness recommendation immediately.
attribution.quote: PITCH provided an alternative suggestion when the user expressed scheduling constraints.

revision.label: not_stated
revision.rationale: Random goal rotation selects predefined content; no durable service-authored mechanism change is reported.

later_use.label: not_stated
later_use.rationale: No execution under a self-revised mechanism is reported.

notes: Independent text-only review; no code repository supplied.
